source_caption_text:
Kodak Black in the studio listening to “ZEZE” before it was released

In 2018, Kodak Black heard the beat that would become “ZEZE” and immediately caught the energy. The infectious melody and heavy drums had him moving around the studio before the song had even become the massive hit fans would eventually know. It was one of those moments where you could tell the artist already knew he had something special.

The behind-the-scenes footage captured Kodak completely locked into the beat, dancing and vibing as the track played. That natural reaction became part of the song’s story, showing just how much energy was already surrounding the record before it officially dropped. Travis Scott and Offset would later join Kodak on the finished version.

When “ZEZE” was released in October 2018, Kodak’s instincts proved to be right. The song debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100, becoming one of the biggest records of his career. Looking back at the studio footage, it really feels like Kodak already knew he was sitting on a banger before the rest of the world even heard it.
